full_credit_rule: Completed valid calculator call; original strict pass OR same numeric leaves and binary/unary operator counts with AST matching after Add/Mult child swaps; numeric result must also match. Integer/float spelling of equal numeric literals is normalized. No reassociation, algebraic simplification or result-only acceptance.
partial_credit_rule: Mutually exclusive maximum tier; 0.3 for exact numeric/operator multiset coverage, 0.1 for executable but mismatched content, otherwise 0. Truncation and out-of-scope records get no arithmetic reward.
prediction_use: Offline comparison of existing outputs only; no development input enters training.
